review_scope: Complete pinned article read; atomic reference assertions only. No full candidate accounting, external dependency completeness, rights, policy adoption or runtime certification.

claims.statement: Pinned reference declares fpt, ghec and ghes applicability; actual plan entitlement remains separate.
Custom pattern expressions use Hyperscan-supported constructs, a subset of PCRE; generic PCRE acceptance is insufficient.
Hyperscan option modifiers are unsupported by custom patterns.
Supported constructs are delegated to linked Hyperscan pattern-support documentation; that external dependency is not fully reviewed here.
More options UI exposes manual regex fields; UI existence is not deployed configuration.
Secret format defines the expression matching the secret itself.
Before-secret default is the pinned expression \A|[^0-9A-Za-z]; preserve expression semantics rather than assuming textual line-start paraphrase is precise.
After-secret default is the pinned expression \z|[^0-9A-Za-z]; preserve expression semantics rather than assuming textual new-line paraphrase is precise.
Additional requirements permit optional positive or negative matching constraints on the secret itself.
Simple tokens commonly need only secret format; additional fields are optional complexity controls, not a mandatory profile.
The example secret-format character class and 5–10 length are illustrative, not adopted enterprise token requirements.
The example after-secret constraint excludes a period; it is not a universal credential policy.
The example requires uppercase and numeric matches as two distinct additional positive constraints.
The example negative constraint excludes consecutive lowercase pairs.
The example special-character constraint is illustrative and must not replace the exact secret-format definition.
Three displayed positive strings and annotated matched substrings are examples, not an executed engine compatibility receipt.
Four displayed negative strings are examples, not exhaustive negative-space verification.
Pinned custom-pattern capacity is up to 500 per organization or enterprise account.
Pinned custom-pattern capacity is up to 100 per repository; repository and higher-scope denominators differ.
